title: Principal and ownership boundary
rule: The only trusted principal is a person id, or an agent connection or run that belongs to that person. Account, session, file, history, asset, and agent-write boundaries check that person id. A caller who does not own the resource gets the same not-found result as a missing resource and no write occurs. No fixture authentication bypass exists.
alternatives: Return 403 with the other person's email when access is denied.
Share one session across people in a workspace.
